finding: Pregnant women with AV have a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, premature rupture of membranes, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean delivery had a lower risk of aerobic vaginitis during pregnancy compared to those with no history of cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at AV diagnosis: 22.3 ± 8.6 weeks
